stories.title: Plaid Cymru leader Rhun ap Iorwerth is Wales’ new First Minister, after securing the backing of Senedd Members
stories.summary: Plaid Cymru leader Rhun ap Iorwerth is Wales’ new First Minister, after securing the backing of Senedd Members in the first Plenary session following the election on May 7. stories.title: Royal composer urges talented young Flintshire musicians to bid for £2,000 prize
stories.summary: Young musicians from Flintshire are being urged to bid for a £2,000 prize at a top festival. Royal composer Paul Mealor is backing the prestigious Pendine Young Musician of Wales competition and telling talented youngsters not to miss out on a “glorious opportunity”. stories.title: New book tells story of children cared for at Chester’s Foundling Hospital branch
stories.summary: A new book on the hundreds of abandoned children cared for at the Chester branch of the Foundling Hospital has been published by the University of Chester Press. stories.title: Councillor Dave Hughes re-elected as leader of Flintshire County Council
stories.summary: Councillor Dave Hughes has been elected leader of Flintshire County Council for another 12 months. stories.title: Plaid Cymru leader Rhun ap Iorwerth confirmed as Wales’ First Minister
stories.summary: Plaid Cymru leader Rhun ap Iorwerth was backed by the Senedd as Wales’ next First Minister on Tuesday, ending 27 years of Labour-led Welsh governments and making him the first Plaid politician nominated to the role.
